# State Management Checklist: SPEC-014B - Harness Adapter Manifest and Fake Registry

**Purpose**: Validate runtime inventory state, lifecycle evidence, assignment visibility, feature-flag, and UI refresh requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-06-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Runtime Inventory State Model

- [x] CHK001 Is the runtime inventory state vocabulary closed to `visible`, `unassigned`, `assigned`, `eligible`, and `blocked`? [Completeness, Spec §Runtime Inventory Envelope]
- [x] CHK002 Is state precedence defined so failed evaluated gates produce `blocked` before other states? [Clarity, Spec §State Management Invariants]
- [x] CHK003 Is `eligible` limited to task-context evaluations where every required gate passes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK004 Are `visible`, `unassigned`, and `assigned` explicitly prevented from implying dispatch permission? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-018]

## Lifecycle Evidence State

- [x] CHK005 Are SPEC-014A lifecycle statuses that can satisfy eligibility explicitly enumerated? [Resolved, Spec §FR-068]
- [x] CHK006 Are terminal, cleanup-pending, cleaned-up, rolled-back, cleanup-failed, owner-incompatible, task-mismatched, stage-mismatched, unauthorized, and absent lifecycle evidence prohibited from producing `eligible`? [Resolved, Spec §FR-069]
- [x] CHK007 Is lifecycle evidence kept read-only and separate from lifecycle mutation authority? [Consistency, Spec §FR-055]

## Assignment And Scope State

- [x] CHK008 Are project-role assignment, task, workspace, governance, and feature-flag evidence required to be same-scope before eligibility? [Resolved, Spec §State Management Invariants]
- [x] CHK009 Is the `role` filter tied to project-agent assignment evidence rather than human user role or legacy agent role state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028]
- [x] CHK010 Are absent, stale, malformed, unauthorized, cross-workspace, and cross-scope evidence cases prohibited from producing eligible state? [Resolved, Data Model §RuntimeInventoryEntry]

## Feature Flag And Refresh State

- [x] CHK011 Is feature-flag-off represented as non-eligible inventory evidence without mutation side effects? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK012 Are UI refresh requirements defined so stale eligible labels are removed when the latest authorized response no longer contains required gates? [Resolved, Spec §FR-067]
- [x] CHK013 Is client-side eligibility inference forbidden outside the latest authorized `runtime_inventory.v1` response? [Resolved, Plan §State Management Source-Of-Truth Decisions]

## Boundary Preservation

- [x] CHK014 Are claim, retry, lifecycle, scheduler, governance, GitHub, tracker, successor, and auto-merge state authorities preserved as read inputs or excluded boundaries? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 5]
- [x] CHK015 Is runtime inventory explicitly prevented from becoming lifecycle authority, claim authority, scheduler state, dispatch state, or client-side inferred eligibility? [Resolved, Spec §FR-067]
- [x] CHK016 Are no-dispatchability-from-visibility requirements traceable to static guards or focused tests? [Traceability, Spec §FR-052]
